pivHint: A YIELD sign tells drivers to give way to others. On a farm, the YIELD is the amount of ______ harvested from a field.
winText: Bumper harvest. YIELD was the pivot - a road sign to the farm's YIELD of CROPS.
lossText: CROPS - plants grown and harvested for food. YIELD was the pivot: a YIELD sign tells drivers to give way, but a farm's YIELD is the amount of CROPS it produces.
